description: Complete framework with LiDAR preview, physics penalty, safety projection, active yaw, and IBPC.
Preview input removed; controller reacts mainly from feedback states.
Reward excludes explicit physical-constraint violation penalty.
Raw PPO action is applied without deterministic post-policy safety projection.
Yaw correction channel removed; only blade-wise pitch actions are retained.
Independent blade pitch removed; pitch action becomes collective or near-collective.
